spans.s: The 4th case-affix is used after a crude-form which ends in an affix denoting 'condition' (abstract noun -- भाववचनाश्च

) and having the force of the affix तुम् (or Infinitive or purpose).

Terms: विभक्ति-4

The affixes तुमुन् and ण्वुल् are placed after a verbal root with the force of the future when the word in construction therewith is another verb, denoting an action performed for the sake of the (future) action.

Terms: तुमुन् and ण्वुल्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the following affixes come after the roots with the force of the affix तुमुन् , viz. 1. से 2. सेन् 3. असे 4. असेन् 5. क्से 6. क्सेन् 7. अध्यै 8. अध्यैन् 9. कध्यै 10. कध्यैन् 11. शाध्यै 12. शाध्यैन् 13. तवै 14. तवै 15. तवैन् ।

Terms: छन्दस्
